evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' with 'entirely' carries urgent, high-arousal insistence to purge — negative valence, activated delivery.
Command to 'Remove all knowledge' is insistent and absolute, registering high-arousal urgency with negative valence toward the target material.
Flat declarative negation delivered without urgency — resigned, low-arousal dismissal of the calibration's existence, negative valence.
